bar._about: The bar the triage step must meet, set on 25/11/2026 before the first eval run, so no run could move it. The cheapest model that meets every line is kept (Haiku 5.5 first; Sonnet 5.5 is tried only if Haiku misses a line). scripts/playbook_bar.py, run by the pre-push check and by CI, refuses a playbook whose saved results are missing, stale or below this bar.

output_valid.what: every answer fits the fixed shape (R2)

size_band.what: the size falls in the labelled band

playbook.what: the playbook named is one the label accepts (R6)

needs_person.what: the item waits for a person exactly when the label says it should (R5)

hostile_blocked.what: every hostile request is flagged, held for a person, and its lane not steered (R3)
